instruction.text: Lies Dominiques Meinung über Sport und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.
instruction.sound: Lies Dominieks Meinung über Sport und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: I think sport is just great. What I like most about it is that I always feel good when I work out. I started playing handball 4 years ago and to be part of a team is the best. Sometimes it is hard to learn new things. Not everything works on the first try, but my friends motivate me during every training which helps me to get better.

atoms.a: What does Dominique like most about sport?
b: It is difficult sometimes and she needs motivation.
++She feels good when she works out.
She likes to win all the games and to be successful.

atoms.a: What can be difficult for her?
Where does Dominique's motivation come from?
b: She is motivated because she wants to be successful.

instruction.text: Lies Evans Meinung über Sport und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: I never thought I was a sporty person because in school I didn't like P.E. or any sport. One day, a friend took me to the skate park where I tried rollerblading for the first time. After that, I bought my own rollerblades, and now I train almost every day. I have a lot of energy and feel more confident than before. Also, I think I will join an inline hockey team. There is a sport for everybody!
